AUTONOMOUS PIPELINE — one LangGraph run per event
feed update · traveller question · scheduled scan
Pydantic schema (gate format, statuses, timezone) · timestamp not in future · prompt-injection / fake-broadcast filter
3 Plan ⇄ 4 Act — AI model (Groq / Gemini / Ollama) or rule planner picks the next tool
tools: context · places · flight by city · read flight · official info → result → plan again · code checks the plan · emergencies by code
Detects gate change · delay ≥ 10 min · cancellation vs last CONFIRMED values · remembers what passengers were told
6 Guard — code only, never an LLM
Broadcasts & nudges: CONFIRMED facts only · replies: CONFIRMED or named single source · no booking ref / phone in text
approve / reject with staff ID · 5-min timeout = NOT sent + duty manager
Re-reconciles live feeds: if anything changed since the draft → abort · otherwise one atomic outbox write
9 Log & report (+ Langfuse) → 10 Streamlit dashboard (traveller · staff · case replay)
DECISION RULES — per field, per flight (4a)
only one fresh feed has it

Thresholds (sahra/config.py): feed stale 15 min · conflict grace 3 min · approval timeout 5 min · arrive 5 min before boarding · nudge 5 min before leave-by · walking 72 / 54 / 36 m·min⁻¹ (standard / family / reduced mobility)
